[SWS_WdgM_CONSTR_06516] Software Cluster related configurations cannot
be used with disabled Software Cluster Support
Status: DRAFT
⌈In case of non-clustered software architecture (WdgMSwClusterSupport is not set
or set to DISABLE_SW_CLUSTER_SUPPORT), the parameters and containers WdgM-
CrossClusterTransition, WdgMTransitionProxy and WdgMBaseSocket shall
not exist.⌋
